title: tectaria jermyi
intro: Tectaria jermyi, commonly known as the Himalayan shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria jermyi are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
